queries.name: entity-workflow-run-totals
queries.subject: Summarize run outcomes and AI Credit consumption for reusable workflow cards.
queries.objective: Compare retained run-attempt activity, recorded conclusions, and AI Credit usage per workflow card.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; expose distinct run-attempt count, success/failure conclusion counts, and sum of recorded AIC, without treating missing run history as zero actual activity.

queries.name: entity-workflows
queries.subject: Project workflow entities for reusable workflow cards and repository drill-down.
queries.objective: Relate declared workflows to observed run and AIC totals for workflow-level drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep declared workflow identity, role, registration, campaign, link, and joined totals; a missing run match defaults to displayed zeros but does not establish no executions or outcomes.

queries.name: repository-runs
queries.subject: Project canonical runs into repository-addressable run evidence.
queries.objective: Expose retained run chronology and status for a selected repository's drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Retain repository coordinate, workflow, run identity, title, event, start time, conclusion, mode, AIC, and run link; absent details or runs do not establish a healthy or idle repository.
queries.description: Workflow runs with a stable repository route key.

queries.name: repository-workflow-totals
queries.subject: Summarize declared and disabled workflow counts by repository.
queries.objective: Compare declared and disabled workflow counts for each repository in the retained workflow inventory.
queries.acceptance: Count declared workflows and workflow-active=false entries by organization and repository; missing declarations must not be interpreted as a complete zero-workflow inventory.
queries.description: Declared and disabled workflow totals for each repository.

queries.name: repository-report-totals
queries.subject: Summarize published outcome report counts by repository.
queries.objective: Show retained outcome-report volume per repository for comparison with observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Count retained outcome rows by organization and repository; a missing aggregate does not prove no reports were published or that reported outcomes succeeded.
queries.description: Published report totals for each repository.

queries.name: repository-run-identities
queries.subject: Project the run-attempt identities needed to match imported evidence.
queries.objective: Keep import-coverage joins narrow without carrying run details, links, or costs.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each selected run attempt and its organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt keys. Do not deduplicate attempts or change selected-horizon semantics.

queries.name: repository-import-totals
queries.subject: Count selected run attempts with matching retained imported records.
queries.objective: Join compact run identities to already reduced event evidence, then reduce import coverage by repository.
queries.acceptance: Match all five run-attempt keys and count each selected run row once when events are positive. Preserve optional-evidence quality and horizon filters; records for unselected runs do not establish coverage.

queries.name: repository-run-totals
queries.subject: Summarize distinct runs, failures, and approval-required runs by repository.
queries.objective: Join already reduced run statistics and import coverage at repository grain.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization and repository; preserve distinct run IDs, configured failure/action-required conclusion counts, and imported-run sums. Missing enrichment or run history must not be treated as complete coverage.
queries.description: Distinct run and conclusion totals for each repository.

queries.name: repository-activity-preview
queries.subject: List repository identities before execution metrics are computed.
queries.objective: Show retained repository identities and drill links while activity metrics are pending.
queries.acceptance: List repositories by organization with repository drill links; this preview does not establish activity totals or outcomes.
queries.description: Fast repository inventory with drill links; activity fields remain pending.

queries.name: repository-activity-core
queries.subject: Join each repository with its workflow, report, and run totals.
queries.objective: Attach retained workflow, report, and run aggregates to each repository for bounded inventory review.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each repository and the available joined aggregates by organization and repository; unmatched metrics remain missing evidence, not confirmed zero activity or evaluated outcomes.
queries.description: Repository inventory joined with workflow, report, evaluation, and run totals.

queries.name: repository-activity
queries.subject: Show repository-level execution health, outcome activity, and AI Credit usage in an actionable inventory.
queries.objective: Prioritize repository drill-down using declared workflows, observed runs, reports, failures, import coverage, and AIC.
queries.acceptance: Return repository identity and link with retained counts, ingestion indicator, failure summary, AIC, and computed status; statuses describe retained evidence only, and an empty or unavailable preview cannot verify health, outcomes, or zero activity.
queries.description: Repository-local execution health and attributed outcome totals.

queries.name: repository-daily-run-buckets
queries.subject: Select repository run counts by whole UTC start-day buckets.
queries.objective: Keep count selection independent of retained Run detail.
queries.acceptance: Use UTC midnight and request bounds, matching the Runs daily chart; do not fabricate sub-day totals or missing days.

queries.name: repository-observed-run-counts
queries.subject: Count observed logical Runs by repository from persistent daily buckets.
queries.objective: Supply the run-volume chart without computing activity health, ingestion coverage, or workflow costs.
queries.acceptance: Sum daily totals, not attempts or retained detail. Select whole UTC start-day buckets by midnight and preserve partial or unavailable coverage.

queries.name: repository-run-inventory
queries.subject: Registered repositories and observed daily logical Run counts.
queries.objective: Compare repository execution volume and choose repositories for drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep top 100 identities and drill links with stable count and repository ordering. Zero means no admitted dated Runs in selected UTC buckets, not inactivity. Preserve partial coverage; unavailable daily evidence must not produce zeros. Table keeps full inventory.

views.title: Workflows
views.description: Declared workflows for the selected repository.
views.empty-message: No workflows were observed for this repository.

pages.intent: Determine which repository most needs CAO operational investigation.
pages.subject: Configured repositories and retained run/issue evidence for the selected horizon.
pages.objective: Prioritize repository-level health and usage review.
pages.acceptance: Preserve repository identity, run counts, issue states and observed AIC units; link repository detail. Inventory membership is not execution, authorized coverage or verified value.
pages.title: Repositories
pages.description: Identify the repository with the strongest need for CAO operational investigation.

views.title: Observed daily runs by repository
views.subject: Registered repositories and observed daily logical Run counts.
views.objective: Compare repository execution volume and choose repositories for drill-down.
views.acceptance: Show top 100 repositories with stable ties and drill links. Count logical Runs, not attempts, in whole UTC start-day buckets selected by midnight. Preserve partial and unavailable coverage; zero is not inactivity. Table retains full inventory.
views.description: Observed logical Runs, not attempts, summed across whole UTC start-day buckets selected by midnight, independently of retained detail. Partial coverage is not complete history; unavailable daily evidence is not zero. Shows up to 100 repositories; Table lists the full inventory with retained-detail metrics.
views.empty-message: No repositories were retained in the current inventory.

views.title: Top repositories with issues
views.subject: Compare retained issue safe outputs across the ten most represented repositories.
views.objective: Identify repositories with issue activity that needs review.
views.acceptance: The ranking describes retained issues, not all repository problems or their resolution.
views.description: The share of retained issues attributed to the ten repositories with the most issue safe outputs.
views.empty-message: No issue safe outputs were retained in the current report.

views.title: Repositories
views.subject: Repository execution health, retained outcomes, and AI Credit usage.
views.objective: Compare repository-grain totals reduced before enrichment and choose drill-down targets.
views.acceptance: Preserve repository identity, counts, links, filters, and evidence quality; unavailable activity is not a healthy or idle repository.
views.description: Repository-local execution health and attributed outcomes, reduced before inventory enrichment.

pages.intent: Find the declared workflows belonging to the selected repository.
pages.subject: Workflow inventory matching the repository route parameter.
pages.objective: Locate authored workflows before inspecting their execution evidence.
pages.acceptance: Retain repository, workflow file and role identities and detail links. Distinguish declared inventory from observed runs and unavailable inventory from an empty result.
pages.title: Repository workflows
pages.description: Locate the selected repository's declared workflows for execution review.

pages.intent: Determine the selected repository's next operational investigation.
pages.subject: One routed repository, its authored workflows and retained runs in the selected horizon.
pages.objective: Choose one repository-specific workflow or run investigation.
pages.acceptance: Show workflow/run counts and AIC with scope and native health distinctions. Preserve missing cost and unavailable evidence; successful runs do not establish accepted outcomes.
pages.title: Repository
pages.description: Choose the next operational investigation for the selected repository.

pages.subject: Retained runs for the routed repository in the selected horizon.
pages.objective: Identify execution-health patterns that warrant workflow-level investigation.
pages.acceptance: Group by native run conclusion and show counts with the selected time bounds. Do not substitute success for effectiveness or interpret missing runs as verified health.
pages.title: Repository
pages.description: Identify execution-health patterns in the selected repository that require workflow review.

views.title: Run health trend
views.subject: Track this repository's daily observed run conclusions.
views.objective: Identify days with failures or changes in run activity for investigation.
views.acceptance: Any apparent trend is checked against underlying runs and data completeness.
views.description: Daily run conclusions show this repository's execution health at a glance.
views.empty-message: No runs have been observed for this repository.

pages.intent: Inspect which authored agentic workflows are registered for the selected repository.
pages.subject: Authored workflow inventory for the routed repository.
pages.objective: Navigate to workflow definitions and their retained execution evidence.
pages.acceptance: Show stable workflow file identity, repository ownership and detail links; distinguish inventory availability from execution activity. Registration alone does not establish a dispatch.
pages.title: Repository
pages.description: Inspect the selected repository's authored agentic workflow inventory.

views.title: Repository workflows
views.description: All declared workflows belonging to this repository, with managed-campaign membership and observed execution totals.

pages.intent: Find recent or problematic workflow runs in the selected repository.
pages.subject: Retained GitHub Actions runs for the routed repository and selected horizon.
pages.objective: Select concrete runs for execution investigation.
pages.acceptance: Preserve run/workflow identity, native status versus conclusion, timestamps and run links; honor repository and horizon filters and disclose partial/unavailable evidence.
pages.title: Repository
pages.description: Select a retained run from the selected repository for execution investigation.

pages.objective: Identify evidence-backed maintenance needs without silently performing updates.
pages.acceptance: Show observed version provenance and unknown states. Registration is not update confidence; refresh inventory when needed, and require explicit approval for operational commands.
pages.title: Repository
pages.description: Decide whether the selected repository's compiler provenance justifies maintenance.
